"""One-off post-run audit; the reusable evaluation entry point is evaluate.py."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()))
from evaluation.core import certify_unitary_rewrite
from evaluation.evidence import read_graph, save_graph, _ordered_audit_graph
from evaluation.workloads import build


def main():
    root = Path(sys.argv[1])
    timeout = float(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 120
    assert 'Run state: finished.' in (root / 'REPORT.md').read_text()
    cells = json.loads((root / 'summary.json').read_text())
    assert len(cells) == 15 and all(c['complete'] for c in cells)
    environment = json.loads((root / 'environment.json').read_text())
    for name, expected in environment['source_hashes'].items():
        if name == 'evaluate.py' and (root / 'post-run-report-link-fix.json').exists():
            documented = json.loads((root / 'post-run-report-link-fix.json').read_text())['source_changes'][name]
            assert documented['recorded'] == expected
            expected = documented['current']
        assert hashlib.sha256(Path(name.replace('\\', '/')).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected, name

    selected = {}
    observed_cases = set()
    for line in (root / 'observations.jsonl').read_text().splitlines():
        row = json.loads(line)
        if row['stage'] == 'benchmark' and not row['warmup']:
            observed_cases.add(row['case'])
            evidence = row['graph_evidence']
            selected.setdefault((evidence['original'], evidence['db']), row)
    assert observed_cases == {c['case'] for c in cells}
    allowed = {'random_clifford', 'random_clifford_t', 'random_t_heavy',
               'layered_local', 'layered_global'}
    first_only = '--first' in sys.argv[3:]
    families = set(sys.argv[3:]) - {'--first'}
    assert not families or families <= allowed
    if families:
        selected = {key: row for key, row in selected.items() if row['spec']['family'] in families}
        observed_cases = {row['case'] for row in selected.values()}
    if first_only:
        selected = dict(list(selected.items())[:1])
        observed_cases = {row['case'] for row in selected.values()}
    suffix = f'-first-{timeout:g}s' if first_only else ''
    destination = root / ('direct-' + '-'.join(sorted(families)) + suffix + '-certificates.json' if families else 'semantic-certificates.json')
    report = json.loads(destination.read_text()) if destination.exists() else {
        'selection': 'Every distinct measured (original, database output) pair across all configurations and repetitions; deduplicated only by exact graph hashes',
        'contract': 'Known unitary circuit input; ordered equivalence up to a nonzero global scalar',
        'source_hashes': environment['source_hashes'],
        'audit_source': Path(__file__).read_text(),
        'attempts': [],
    }
    report['families'] = sorted(families or allowed)
    report['first_only'] = first_only
    assert report['source_hashes'] == environment['source_hashes']
    report['selected_pairs'] = len(selected)
    report['covered_configurations'] = len(observed_cases)
    for row in selected.values():
        assert row['variant'] == 'optimized' and row['rule'] == 'full_reduce'
        assert row['spec']['family'] in allowed
        original_key = row['graph_evidence']['original']
        output_key = row['graph_evidence']['db']
        if any(a['original_key'] == original_key and a['output_key'] == output_key
               and a['certificate']['status'] == 'verified' for a in report['attempts']):
            continue
        original = build(row['spec'])
        assert save_graph(root / 'graphs', original) == original_key
        result = _ordered_audit_graph(read_graph(root / 'graphs', output_key))
        assert save_graph(root / 'graphs', result) == output_key
        start = time.perf_counter()
        certificate = certify_unitary_rewrite(original, result, timeout)
        report['attempts'].append(dict(case=row['case'], spec=row['spec'],
                                      original_key=original_key, output_key=output_key,
                                      payload_hash_preserved=True, timeout_s=timeout,
                                      elapsed_s=time.perf_counter() - start,
                                      certificate=certificate))
        destination.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
        print(row['spec']['family'], row['spec']['seed'], certificate['status'], flush=True)
    destination.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
